purpose: Map independently adjudicated historical control/presence evidence to stored Pineland v5 latent state only when construct, geography, and time are compatible.
spatial_compatibility_rules: A district-wide historical claim may be compared with district-level checkpoint control if its observation construct has a declared dimension mapping.
A district-headquarters, VDC, village, road-corridor, school, market, or named-subdistrict claim must not be compared with district-wide control as if it described the whole district.

A locality-specific armed-presence claim may be scored only if the historical locality can be mapped unambiguously to a Pineland locality and dated fielded-presence state can be reconstructed from stored formation/movement history.
Community cooperation/sympathy is not a substitute for armed presence, administrative presence, or control.
No spatial aggregation or disaggregation may be chosen after looking at model values.
temporal_compatibility_rules: Use only checkpoints or reconstructed state whose timestamp lies within the source interval, unless a predeclared nearest-time tolerance is established before values are inspected.
Do not carry historical observations forward/backward outside the source interval.
Do not treat a yearlong source interval as continuous presence if the source wording does not support continuity.

government_armed_presence.fallback: unscored construct evidence if dated local presence cannot be reconstructed

maoist_armed_presence.preferred_model_state: dated insurgent formation presence at compatible locality
maoist_armed_presence.fallback: unscored construct evidence if dated local presence cannot be reconstructed

maoist_shadow_governance.note: Specific taxation evidence primarily informs fiscal reach; NGO/permit/rule enforcement may inform administrative/legal reach. Do not collapse unlike observables without an explicit operator.

checkpoint_or_patrol_presence.fallback: unscored if dated patrol/post history is not retained

security_post_or_garrison_presence.fallback: unscored if dated post state is not retained

territorial_access_constraint.note: A blockade is evidence about access/physical authority, not automatically a district control category.

scoring_rule.primary: score only construct-compatible, spatially compatible, temporally compatible observations
scoring_rule.incompatible_rows: retain with reason as informative but unscored
scoring_rule.ensemble: report all eight fixed Nepal v5 members; do not promote a partial ensemble
scoring_rule.uncertainty: retain source coding uncertainty separately from model ensemble variation
